coverage_gaps: No separate Dos Lagos Amphitheater event was verified for November 27-29; the official tree-lighting page explicitly places its temporary stage in the central shopping plaza.
No scheduled City of Corona park program for November 27-29 appeared on the official calendar reviewed November 26.
The Open Create listing does not state a fee, registration requirement or remaining capacity.
The two rights-cleared images are illustrative or archival and are not photographs of this weekend's events.
Ticket prices are listed as starting prices and event availability remains subject to organizer changes.
